message.content: { "title": "Kai Dynasty Adventure", "language": "en", "recommended_level": "Medium", "hook": "The party starts their journey in a camp, which serves as a tool to gather the party, introduce them to the adventure, and let them purchase gear they need. The camp also introduces the player to the three siblings Akai, Likai, and Takai, who are very friendly but not very talkative. They try to keep to themselves and attempt to bring Akai away from the party. The siblings will go to the Kai Monastery, which is a tenday into the Anauroch, before the caravan departs. Likai still has preparations to make for the wedding, and they are only at the camp to meet Akai, who insists that the players should come along to the monastery. When the players are ready, they will depart.", "npcs": [ { "name": "Akai", "role": "Siblings of the main character, very friendly but not very talkative. They try to keep to themselves and attempt to bring Akai away from the party. They will go to the Kai Monastery, which is a tenday into the Anauroch, before the caravan departs. Likai still has preparations to make for the wedding, and they are only at the camp to meet Akai, who insists that the players should come along to the monastery. When the players are ready, they will depart." }, { "name": "Likai", "role": "Siblings of the main character, very friendly but not very talkative. They try to keep to themselves and attempt to bring Akai away from the party. They still have preparations to make for the wedding and are only at the camp to meet Akai, who insists that the players should come along to the monastery. When the players are ready, they will depart." }, { "name": "Takai", "role": "Siblings of the main character, very friendly but not very talkative. They try to keep to themselves and attempt to bring Akai away from the party. They still have preparations to make for the wedding and are only at the camp to meet Akai, who insists that the players should come along to the monastery. When the players are ready, they will depart." }, { "name": "Bell", "role": "NPC who may be with the party, who can be used for side quests. They are a mysterious figure who can be found at the camp. They are not present at the oasis when the party arrives, and if Bell isn’t with the party, then they will meet Gimp and his three henchmen on their way to the cave. They are also a potential ally for the party." }, { "name": "Gimp", "role": "NPC who may be with the party, who can be used for side quests. They are a mysterious figure who can be found at the camp. They are not present at the oasis when the party arrives, and if Bell isn’t with the party, then they will meet Gimp and his three henchmen on their way to the cave. They are also a potential ally for the party." }, { "name": "Druid", "role": "NPC who can be found in a large underground cavern with trees, roots, and vines. The druid requires the party to leave anything made of metal here. They have a puzzle for the party to solve, which is to touch the star without touching the water. The druid has a puzzle for the party to solve, which is to touch the star without touching the water. The druid requires the party to leave anything made of metal here. They have a puzzle for the party to solve, which is to touch the star without touching the water. The druid requires the party to leave anything made of metal here. They have a puzzle for the party to solve, which is to touch the star without touching the water." } ], "locations": [ "The camp", "The cave to retrieve the herb", "The Kai Monastery", "The first oasis", "The Anauroch" ], "threats": [ "The party is separated from Akai, Likai, and Takai in the Anauroch. The party can attempt to travel towards the cave to retrieve the herb, or towards a nearby cave they can see, or towards the mirage of a nearby oasis, which is actually the abode of a druid. If all fails, then let a sandstorm hit the party. In this case the party will be saved by the druid but Likai and Takai will capture Akai and hurry towards the Kai Monastery. If this presents itself as a challenge, Likai and Takai can always capture Akai while the party is trying to solve the druid’s puzzle as described later.", "The party is lost in the Anauroch and must make a Wisdom (Survival) check to avoid becoming lost. If the party is moving at a slow pace, the navigator gains a +5 bonus to the check, and a fast pace imposes a -5 penalty. If the party gets lost before reaching the first oasis, then let the druid save them. After meeting the druid, the party will find their way to the first oasis, which is magical in nature and which therefore finds them even if they are lost. At this oasis the party should meet Gimp and three of his henchmen, who have disguised themselves as entertainers for the Kai wedding in the hopes of stealing from the Kai Monastery.", "The party is separated from Akai, Likai, and Takai in the Anauroch. The party can attempt to travel towards the cave to retrieve the herb, or towards a nearby cave they can see, or towards the mirage of a nearby oasis, which is actually the abode of a druid. If all fails, then let a sandstorm hit the party. In this case the party will be saved by the druid but Likai and Takai will capture Akai and hurry towards the Kai Monastery. If this presents itself as a challenge, Likai and Takai can always capture Akai while the party is trying to solve the druid’s puzzle as described later.", "The party is lost in the Anauroch and must make a Wisdom (Survival) check to avoid becoming lost. If the party is moving at a slow pace, the navigator gains a +5 bonus to the check, and a fast pace imposes a -5 penalty. If the party gets lost before reaching the first oasis, then let the druid save them. After meeting the druid, the party will find their way to the first oasis, which is magical in nature and which therefore finds them even if they are lost. At this oasis the party should meet Gimp and three of his henchmen, who have disguised themselves as entertainers for the Kai wedding in the hopes of stealing from the Kai Monastery." ], "rewards": [ "The druid gives the party a creature of their choice that the druid gives them. They can choose from any of the creatures present in the cavern. Each creature grants an additional party bonus.", "The party can gather a container of water and bring the water up to the ceiling by climbing the trees on the outskirts of the cavern, which will have the star move out to the opposite end of the cavern and down to the ground. Climbing the trees requires a Strength (Athletics) check DC 10.", "The party solves the puzzle and the druid gives the party a creature of their choice that the druid gives them. They can choose from any of the creatures present in the cavern. Each creature grants an additional party bonus." ] }
